name: open_on_only_summaries_before_date
query: SELECT flag, count(*) AS n, min(date) AS first, max(date) AS last FROM OPEN ON 2016-01-01 WHERE date < 2016-01-01 GROUP BY flag
notes: Before the OPEN date only the S postings remain, all dated 2015-12-31. Their number (90) is two per summarized position, so it depends on the lots.
